title: SL 631H (NSIC Rc 728H) Hybrid Rice: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: SL 631H (NSIC Rc 728H): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: SL 631H is NSIC Rc 728H, a hybrid rice for irrigated lowland: about 114 days and 7.1 tonnes per hectare on average. See its ratings.
excerpt: NSIC Rc 728H is a hybrid rice variety for irrigated lowland, sold as SL 631H and known locally as Mestiso 139. The NSIC approved it in 2022. SL Agritech bred it. It matures in about 114 days and averages 7.1 tonnes per hectare, with a top yield of 9.5 tonnes in trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for SL 631H, or rice variety 728H, this is the one. Compare it with the other varieties in our [rice variety finder](/rice-varieties) before you buy seed. Also read our guide to [rice varieties in the Philippines](/crops/rice-varieties-philippines) for how inbreds, hybrids and special rice differ.

items: **Yield:** 7.1 tonnes per hectare on average, or about 142 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 9.5 tonnes.
**Holds up against:** rice blast, stem borer.
**Watch out for:** bacterial leaf blight, tungro, green leafhopper.
**Cooked rice:** low amylose, so soft and tender.

blocks.caption: Key facts of NSIC Rc 728H (t/ha means tonnes per hectare)

blocks.text: How much does NSIC Rc 728H yield?

On average it gives 7.1 tonnes per hectare. That is about 142 cavans of 50 kilograms of palay. It sits above the average of the 180 irrigated lowland hybrids on the list, which is 6.9 tonnes. But the top yield, 9.5 tonnes, came from a trial with good water, seed and care. So plan your costs on the average, then work toward the top with the habits in our guide to [raising rice yield per hectare](/blog/increase-rice-yield-per-hectare).
How many days does it take to mature?

It takes about 114 days from sowing to harvest. Varieties of 100 to 120 days count as short duration and 120 to 140 days as medium, so this one counts as short duration. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains turn golden yellow. Because the day count drives every task, anee.io counts it for you from each lot's own planting day, with the [growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: So scout early for [bacterial leaf blight](/diseases/bacterial-leaf-blight), [tungro](/diseases/rice-tungro), [green leafhopper](/pests/green-leafhopper). When you see the first signs, check the guide before you spray, because the right timing saves more than an extra dose. If you are not sure what you see, our [pest and disease finders](/features/pest-and-disease-finders) help you name it from the damage.

Amylose decides how rice cooks. With low amylose, expect rice that is soft. In fact, Filipino taste has moved from high to intermediate and low amylose rice, because people want it softer. Head rice is the share of whole grains after milling. So a higher number means fewer broken grains and a better price at the mill.

It suits irrigated lowland, where you control the water. Level the field well so the water stands evenly, and plant together with the farms around you, so pests cannot move from field to field. Our guide to [rice land preparation](/land-preparation/rice-land-preparation) shows each step. For the right month in your province, see [the best time to plant rice](/blog/best-time-to-plant-rice-philippines).

items.q: Is SL 631H the same as NSIC Rc 728H?
items.a: Yes. SL 631H is the name it is sold under, and NSIC Rc 728H is its registration with the National Seed Industry Council, where its local name is Mestiso 139. The numbers on this page are for NSIC Rc 728H.

items.q: What is the local name of NSIC Rc 728H?
items.a: It is known as Mestiso 139. Seed sellers and agriculturists use both names, so ask for either one.

items.q: How many days does NSIC Rc 728H take to harvest?
items.a: About 114 days after sowing. Then harvest when 85 to 90 percent of the grains are golden yellow.

items.q: What is the average yield of NSIC Rc 728H?
items.a: It averages 7.1 tonnes per hectare, about 142 cavans of 50 kilograms. The best trial reached 9.5 tonnes. Your own yield depends on water, seed, fertilizer and timing.
Yes. So buy new seed each season, because seed saved from a hybrid crop does not grow true and yields less.

items.q: What should I watch for when I plant it?
items.a: In trials it was weak against bacterial leaf blight, tungro, green leafhopper. So scout from the early weeks and act at the first signs.
